aliases: 一种环磺酮产品的纯化方法
notes: Named only in the invention title at field (54), line 42, 一种环磺酮产品的纯化方法, so the role is the product of the process this patent claims. 环磺酮 is tembotrione; it is not sulcotrione and not mesotrione, and nothing in this section prints either of those. The printed form is 环磺酮产品 (tembotrione product), which is the compound plus the word for product, so the identifier follows the shared canonical form and the printed variant and the full title line are kept as aliases. commercially_available is false per rule 11 because later parts of this document prepare the compound; the field answers whether a step of this document makes it and not whether it can be bought, and tembotrione is a marketed herbicide. is_section_product is false because this section is bibliographic metadata and is headed by the issuing office line at field (19), not by a compound. This section is a front page: it gives no quantity, no characterisation and no drawn structure, so those fields are null rather than objects whose members are all null. No chemical_family or functional_group tag is emitted because the front page prints no class term for the compound and no structure. Seen and deliberately not emitted as compounds: the two (51) Int.Cl. codes C07C 317/24 and C07C 315/06 at lines 34 and 35, which are classifications of subject matter and not substances, and the (73) patentee, (73) address, (72) inventors, (74) agency and agent and the examiner name, which are parties rather than chemistry.
